title: i made an SAO style MMO. the town choir sings your build.
author: Solid-6
selftext:
One life. Clear a floor boss and the floor opens for the whole server. The Town of Beginnings choir sings about the heroes who did it, including their crafts and best gear.



I made Spawn Art Online by talking with Savi on Spawn. I chose permadeath and shared progression. When the weapon grips kept coming out wrong, I asked for arm controls and posed every weapon myself, then every dual wield pairing, one by one.



The choir came after a player cleared floor 1. I added it to celebrate that clear. Now each floor gets one ballad, built around the heroes who earned it.
